cc:Work.dc:title: Dohnuts 0.1.0 — model overview and benchmarks
cc:Work.dc:description: Qwen3.5-0.8B multimodal decision model, post-trained on one RX 7900 XTX. Seed 42, update 3600. JevBench public-task accuracy, visual and multilingual task comparisons, and same-GPU warm latency. See panel captions for protocols.
